items.reason: The investigational intervention is the device: 'Determine the safety of Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) started concurrently with 5 fraction stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) and temozolomide'; under D31-C1 a trial testing a device (TTFields) is excluded_intervention_type, not no_pharmacological_candidate. Temozolomide is background and gadolinium is diagnostic.
